tm.「……何度読んでも すばらしい文章だ。\n キミには ぜひ この手紙の続きを\n: "...No matter how many times I read it, it's wonderful. Please do find the rest of this letter.
tm.「村の人に 聞いた話だと この手紙は\n ラムダの蔵書に はさまっていたらしいよ: "I heard this letter was tucked in a book from Arboria's collection.
tm.「……おおっ キミか！\n あの手紙の続きが わかったのかい？: "...Oh, it's you! Did you find the rest of that letter?
tm.「そっか。それは 残念だな～。\n どうしても 続きが気になるから\n わかった: "I see. That's a shame. I'm so curious about the rest, so tell me soon if you find out...
tm.{var:1}は\n手紙の続きを 教えた！:
{var:1} told him the rest
of the letter!
tm.「ふむふむ これで全部か。\n じゃあ つなげて 読んでみるね。: "Hmm, hmm, so that's all of it. Then I'll read it connected.
tm.「でも なぜでしょう。世界は 変わらず\n 美しいままなのに あなたがいない……: "But why? The world is as beautiful as ever, yet you're not here... That alone makes everything look faded.
tm.「ああ ムネが 張り裂けそう……。\n ローシュ……あなたと会えない日々が\n: "Oh, my heart is about to burst... Erdwin... Days without seeing you are so painful...
tm.「いつかまた 会える日が来ると信じて\n 私は 今日も ひとり竪琴を奏でます。\: "Believing the day will come when we meet again, today too I play my harp alone. So this melody may reach you...
tm.「……う～ん。なんて 情熱的な手紙なんだ。\n でも このローシュってのは……\: "...Mmm. What a passionate letter. But this Erdwin... could it be the legendary Luminary Erdwin?!
tm.「そうか！ たしか 勇者ローシュと賢者セニカは\n 恋人同士だったはず。これは: "Of course! Luminary Erdwin and Sage Senya were lovers. This is a love letter Senya sent Erdwin! No doubt!
tm.「まさか 神話に語られる人物の\n こんな情熱的な 恋文を読めるなんて……。\n: "To think I could read such a passionate love letter from figures of myth... It feels like I'm witnessing the legend itself.
tm.「キミには きちんと お礼をしないとね。\n ほら これを受け取ってくれ。: "I must thank you properly. Here, please take this.
tm.「いにしえの時代に生きた ふたりの手紙……\n ああ なんて ロマンチックなんだ: "A letter between two people from ancient times... how romantic. Reading a wonderful love letter puts me in the best mood.
tm.「なんだか ローシュとセニカの恋を題材にして\n 新しい歌を 作れそうな気がする: "I feel like I could write a new song about Erdwin and Senya's love. That's all thanks to you. Thanks.
tm.「さあ 勇者 {var:1}よ。\n じゅんびが ととのったら\n 時のオーブの:
"Now, Luminary {var:1}.
When you are ready, come before
the Orb of Time...
